Rajani’s ordeal began on an ordinary morning when she suddenly developed slurred speech and complete weakness on her right side.

stories.summary: The Centre for Research on Energy and Clean Air (CREA) conducted a systematic review of peer-reviewed studies published between 1975 and 2025, following international PRISMA 2020 guidelines. stories.title: Cyclone Akvan: What makes a storm severe, very severe or super cyclonic? IMD's classifications explained
stories.summary: What do these classifications mean, and how does the IMD determine a cyclone's intensity? Cyclonic disturbances are classified based on the maximum sustained wind speed around their centre. As per the weather body, the stronger the winds, the higher the category assigned to the weather system. The department measures sustained wind speed as an average over three minutes, rather than using short-lived, stronger gusts.

stories.title: Explainer: What is the polar vortex and what could it mean for winter?
stories.summary: The polar vortex can refer to two different weather systems: the stratospheric polar vortex and the tropospheric polar vortex. Of current interest is the stratospheric one, a ring of strong west-to-east winds that circles and helps trap extremely cold air above the Arctic, around 10 to 50 km above the Earth’s surface.

stories.title: How did Jaden Agassi step out of his famous parents' shadow? Meet Andre Agassi and Steffi Graf's son chas

stories.title: Can poor air quality raise your risk of pneumonia? Experts explain what keeps you protected and what doesn't
stories.summary: Exposure to polluted air, smoke and harmful particles can weaken the lungs' natural defence mechanisms, increasing vulnerability to respiratory infections such as pneumonia. stories.title: From Karna to Sita: The legends from the Mahabharata and Ramayana associated with Chhath Puja
stories.summary: Every year, Chhath Puja brings devotees to water bodies to offer prayers to Surya Dev, the Sun God. While the evening offering is made to the setting Sun, devotees return the next morning to pray to the rising Sun.

stories.title: Chhath Puja 2026: The story of Chhathi Maiyaa, the mother goddess who protects children and blesses families during Chhath Puja
stories.summary: Chhath Puja is commonly associated with the worship of Surya Dev, but the festival also honors Chhathi Maiyaa, who is worshipped as a mother goddess and protector of children. Devotees seek her blessings for the good health and long life of their children, as well as happiness and prosperity in their families.
